info.name: Omni, Powered by Engine Content Service API

items.docs: Retrieves details for the set of properties specified in the request

info.name: List properties near a point of interest.

params.name: request.criteria.radius.physicalAddress.recipients
params.description:
Optionally, any individual recipients.
For example, "Alexander Hamilton", "Aaron Burr"
May be empty.

params.name: request.criteria.radius.physicalAddress.organization
params.description:
Optionally, any organization or company as a recipient.
For example, "Engine".

params.name: request.criteria.radius.physicalAddress.addressLine
params.description:
Optionally, any address lines, in order as they'd appear on an envelope.
For example, "233 S Wacker Dr", "108th Floor".
May be empty.

params.name: request.criteria.radius.physicalAddress.administrativeArea
params.description:
Optionally, the State, province, prefecture, oblast, or area.
For example, "Texas"

params.name: request.criteria.radius.physicalAddress.locality
params.description:
Optionally, the City, or Post Town
For example, "Austin"

params.name: request.criteria.radius.physicalAddress.postalCode
params.description:
Optionally, the postal code, if one exists, for the address.
For example, "78757".

params.name: request.criteria.radius.physicalAddress.countryCode
params.description:
Optionally, the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.
For example, "US".
See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2
See https://www.iso.org/iso-3166-country-codes.html

params.name: request.criteria.radius.freeformSearchText
params.description:
A description of a point of interest, an unstructured address, etc.
Freeform input will make a "best effort" match to a point of interest and its corresponding geo coordinates.
If available, using `coordinates` or `physical_address` will yield better results.

params.name: request.criteria.radius.radius.unit
params.description:
The unit of distance measurement.

 - DISTANCE_UNIT_MILE: A mile in the imperial system of units.
 - DISTANCE_UNIT_KILOMETER: A kilometer in the international system of units (metric).

params.name: request.criteria.excludePropertiesWithoutHeroImage
params.description:
Optionally, if true, properties that do not have a `Property#hero_image_uri` will not be returned.
Excluded properties will not count against the page size or limit.

params.name: request.criteria.excludePropertiesWithoutDescription
params.description:
Optionally, if true, properties that do not have a `Property#description` will not be returned.
Excluded properties will not count against the page size or limit.

params.name: request.criteria.sortMode
params.description:
The order in which the properties will be returned.

 - PROPERTY_SORT_MODE_DISTANCE: Results are returned in ascending order from the center point of the `ListProperties.inclusion_type`.

params.name: request.pageSize
params.description:
The maximum number of search results to be returned in a page.
Default: 100
Minimum: 1
Maximum: 500
